customMethods.script:
''' 
 		Exports item information and associated data such as attributes and classes
 		 
 		Args: 
 			itemIds (list[int]): list of itemIds
 		Returns: 
 			exportInfo (dict) 
 			message (string): None if successful 
 		Updated: 
 			jz  10/14/25 created
 	'''
 	dbName = system.kanoa.config.getDBName('core') 
 	log = system.util.getLogger('kanoa_item')
 	
	import java.lang
	
	itemIds = [row['itemId'] for row in self.view.custom.itemTable.selection.data]
 	log.info("exportItem() called with %s"%(itemIds)) 
 	exportInfo = {}
 	
 	try:
		items = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.item.getItems(({'itemIdList': itemIds})))
		itemClassIds = list(set([item['itemClassId'] for item in items if item['itemClassId']]))
		itemClasses = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.item.getItemClasses(({'itemClassIdList': itemClassIds})))
		itemAttributes = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.item.getItemAttributes(({'itemIdList': itemIds})))
		
 		exportInfo['items'] = items
		exportInfo['itemClasses'] = itemClasses
		exportInfo['itemAttributes'] = itemAttributes
	 	
 		data = system.util.jsonDecode(str(system.util.jsonEncode(exportInfo)))
 		fileName = 'Items Export ({}).json'.format(system.date.format(system.date.now(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'))
	
		document = system.util.jsonEncode({'exportType': 'itemInfo', 'data': system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(data))})
		system.perspective.download(fileName, document)
		
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Items exported'})
 		 
 	except java.lang.Exception, e:
 		log.error("exportItem() threw exception %s "%(e.cause))
 		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': 'Items failed to export: %s'%e.cause})
	
	return

# implement your handler here
	'''
		Imports all item info including item class, state links, asset links, and item attributes (kanoaOPS)
		Args:
			exportInfo: dict
			userId: int
		Returns:
			success: bit
			msg: string
		Updated:
			10/14/25 JZ Created
	'''
	
	log = system.util.getLogger('kanoaItemImporter')
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	exportInfo = payload['exportInfo']['data']
		
	import java.lang
		
	roleId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('roleId', system.kanoa.security.getRoles({'roleName': 'Administrator'}))
	
	self.view.custom.info = {'showBar': True, 'text': 'Importing items...', 'type': 'INFO'}
	# add item class data
	itemClassesAdded = 0
	itemClasses = exportInfo['itemClasses']
	itemClassIdMap = {}
	for itemClass in itemClasses:
		itemClassDict = dict(itemClass)
		itemClassPathParts = []
		itemClassPaths = {}
		for part in itemClassDict['path'].split('\\'):
			itemClassPathParts.append(part)		
			classPath = '\\'.join(itemClassPathParts)
			if classPath in itemClassPaths: continue
			itemClassPaths[classPath] = {'itemClassPath': classPath, 'itemClassColor': itemClassDict['itemClassColor'] if classPath == itemClassDict['path'] else None}
			
		for itemClassInfo in sorted(itemClassPaths.values(), key=lambda x: x['itemClassPath']):
			itemClassId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemClassId', system.kanoa.item.getItemClasses({'itemClassPath': itemClassInfo['itemClassPath']}))
			if itemClassId: 
				itemClassIdMap[itemClassDict['itemClassId']] = itemClassId
				continue
			
			pathSplit = itemClassInfo['itemClassPath'].split('\\')
			parentPath = '\\'.join(pathSplit[:-1]) if len(pathSplit) > 1 else None
			parentId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemClassId', system.kanoa.item.getItemClasses({'itemClassPath': parentPath})) if parentPath else None		
			itemClassInfo = {'itemClassName': pathSplit[-1], 'parentId': parentId, 'itemClassDescription': None, 'itemClassColor': itemClassInfo['itemClassColor'], 'enabled': True}		
			newItemClassId = system.kanoa.item.addItemClass(itemClassInfo, userId)
			itemClassesAdded += 1
			itemClassIdMap[itemClassDict['itemClassId']] = newItemClassId
	
	
	# add item, or get item ID if already exists in database
	itemsAdded = 0
	items = exportInfo['items']
	itemIdMap = {}
	for item in items:
		itemId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemId', system.kanoa.item.getItems({'itemPath': item['itemPath']}))
		if itemId: 
			itemIdMap[item['itemId']] = itemId
			continue
		
		itemInfo = dict(item)
		if itemClassIdMap.has_key(itemInfo['itemClassId']): itemInfo['itemClassId'] = itemClassIdMap[itemInfo['itemClassId']]
		newItemId = system.kanoa.item.addItem(itemInfo, userId)
		itemsAdded += 1
		itemIdMap[itemInfo['itemId']] = newItemId
	
	# add item attributes
	itemAttributesAdded = 0
	itemAttributes = exportInfo['itemAttributes']
	for itemAttribute in itemAttributes:
		itemId = itemIdMap[itemAttribute['itemId']] if itemIdMap.has_key(itemAttribute['itemId']) else itemAttribute['itemId']
		itemAttributeData = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.item.getItemAttributes({'itemId': itemId, 'itemAttrName': itemAttribute['itemAttrName']}))
		if len(itemAttributeData) == 0:
			itemAttributeInfo = dict(itemAttribute)
			itemAttributeInfo['itemId'] = itemId
			system.kanoa.item.addItemAttribute(itemAttributeInfo, userId)
			itemAttributesAdded += 1
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', payload={'message': '%s items, %s item classes, %s item attributes imported'%(itemsAdded, itemClassesAdded, itemAttributesAdded)})
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.itemTable.data")
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.itemClasses.data")
	
	self.view.custom.info = {'showBar': False, 'text': '', 'type': 'INFO'}
	return {'passed': True, 'message': 'Items imported'}
